description: This Java class defines an abstract parser for Acknowledgement objects from JSON data, including methods for extracting fields, validation, and error handling.

classes.name: AcknowledgementJsonParser
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for parsing Acknowledgement objects from JSON data, parameterized by EntityId type.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method executing the parsing process to convert a JsonObject into an Acknowledgement.

methods.name: tryToGetAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve and parse the acknowledgement label, throwing a JsonParseException if invalid.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Extracts the acknowledgement label from the JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Extracts and retrieves the entity ID from the JSON object.

methods.name: tryToGetEntityId
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence into an entity ID of type I, with error handling for invalid data.

methods.name: createEntityIdInstance
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement, creating an entity ID instance from a CharSequence.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Retrieves the entity type from the JSON object for validation.

methods.name: validateEntityType
methods.description: Checks if the actual entity type matches the expected type, throws exception if not.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Fetches and converts the status code from JSON, ensuring validity.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs DittoHeaders from JSON.

methods.name: getPayloadOrNull
methods.description: Optional method to extract payload data, handling null values.
